# packages/graph/src/test

Comprehensive Vitest test suite for the Codemix graph query engine covering Cypher-like grammar parsing via `parse()` from [../grammar.js](./../grammar.js), AST-to-execution-step conversion via `astToSteps()` from [../astToSteps.js](./../astToSteps.js), traversal execution via `createTraverser()` and `QueryContext` from [../Steps.js](./../steps/index.js), and integration validation against `InMemoryGraphStorage` from [../GraphStorage.js](./../GraphStorage.js). Tests span core graph operations ([Graph.test.ts](./Graph.test.ts), [GraphStorage.test.ts](./GraphStorage.test.ts)), traversal DSL ([Traversals.test.ts](./Traversals.test.ts), [ComplexTraversals.test.ts](./ComplexTraversals.test.ts)), query execution pipelines ([queryExecution.test.ts](./queryExecution.test.ts)), exception hierarchies ([Exceptions.test.ts](./Exceptions.test.ts)), and openCypher TCK compliance (nested in [tck/](./tck/)).

## Contents

### Grammar & Parser Validation

- [grammar.test.ts](./grammar.test.ts) — 70+ test cases validating `parse()` output for `NodePattern` (variable, labels, properties), `EdgePattern` (direction, quantifiers `[*2]`, `[*1..3]`), `PropertyCondition`, `ExistsCondition`, `AndCondition`/`OrCondition`, `RETURN` aggregates, `ORDER BY`, `SKIP`/`LIMIT`, and @-prefixed metadata identifiers.
- [cypher-comparison.test.ts](./cypher-comparison.test.ts) — openCypher v9/M23 compatibility matrix categorizing features as SUPPORTED, NOT SUPPORTED, PARTIAL, DIFFERENT, or CODEMIX EXTENSION; validates AST node types including `UnionQuery`, `MultiPattern`, `ArithmeticExpression`, `StringPredicateCondition`, `XorCondition`, `RegexCondition`, `ExistsSubquery`, `LabelOr`/`LabelAnd`/`LabelNot`/`LabelWildcard`.
- [cypher-syntax-check.test.ts](./cypher-syntax-check.test.ts) — Extended syntax validation covering `WITH` clauses, nested property objects, `WHERE NOT` conditions, and `CREATE` relationship chaining.
- [numericLiterals.test.ts](./numericLiterals.test.ts) — Hexadecimal (`0xFF`), octal (`0o755`), scientific notation (`1e10`, `1.5e3`), and unary minus parsing.
- [backtickIdentifiers.test.ts](./backtickIdentifiers.test.ts) — Backtick-quoted identifiers for variables (`` `my node` ``), labels (`` `User Type` ``), relationship types (`` `KNOWS WELL` ``), properties (`` n.`first name` ``), and parameters (`` $`param name` ``).
- [keywordAsIdentifier.test.ts](./keywordAsIdentifier.test.ts) — Reserved words (`labels`, `type`, `count`, `match`, `sum`) as valid aliases and variable references, with pattern binding restrictions throwing for `MATCH (labels:Person)`.

### Execution & Traversal Integration

- [queryExecution.test.ts](./queryExecution.test.ts) — End-to-end pipeline validation using `executeQuery()` helper chaining `parse()` → `astToSteps()` → `createTraverser().traverse()`; covers simple vertex queries, edge traversal (`follows`, `likes`), aggregation (`COUNT`, `SUM`), pagination (`LIMIT`, `SKIP`), boolean logic, `DISTINCT` deduplication, and `labels()` function.
- [traversalSteps.test.ts](./traversalSteps.test.ts) — `GraphTraversal` step implementations: `repeat()` with `times()`, `until()`, `emit()` modifiers; `shortestPath()` with BFS unweighted and Dijkstra weighted (`weightedBy("weight")`, `weightedBy("cost")`); boundary conditions for cyclic graphs, unreachable nodes, `maxDepth(0)` for zero-length paths.
- [ComplexTraversals.test.ts](./ComplexTraversals.test.ts) — `repeat()` API termination strategies, emission patterns, nested traversals, step labeling (`as("start")`, `as("hop")`, `as("end")`), bidirectional navigation (`both("knows")`), aggregation (`count()`), and performance boundaries (100-vertex chain <1000ms).
- [EdgeTraversal.test.ts](./EdgeTraversal.test.ts) — Gremlin-style edge operations: navigation (`outV()`, `inV()`, `bothV()`, `otherV()`), filtering (`hasLabel`, `has`), step labeling (`as`, `select`), set algebra (`union`, `intersect`, `dedup`), pagination (`limit`, `skip`, `range`), counting, value extraction (`map`, `property`, `properties`), and ordering (`order().by("strength", "desc")`).
- [OrderTraversal.test.ts](./OrderTraversal.test.ts) — `order().by(property, direction)` with 30 test cases covering single/multi-property sort keys (`by("age", "asc").by("name", "desc")`), integration with filters, pagination, `repeat` operations, and performance thresholds (<500ms for 100 vertices).
- [ShortestPath.test.ts](./ShortestPath.test.ts) — Shortest path algorithms: `shortestPath().to(targetId)`, `through("knows", "likes")`, `direction("out"|"in"|"both")`, `maxDepth(n)`, `weightedBy("weight")` (skips negative weights, defaults missing to 1), BFS vs Dijkstra correctness, cycle handling, and performance (<1000ms for 100-vertex chain).

### Data Mutations & CRUD

- [create.test.ts](./create.test.ts) — `CREATE` clause parsing and execution: `CREATE (var:Label)`, inline properties `{key: value}`, comma-separated patterns, `CreateStep` generation.
- [writeOperations.test.ts](./writeOperations.test.ts) — Write operation semantics: `DELETE`/`DETACH DELETE`, `REMOVE` property deletion, `MERGE` with `ON CREATE SET`/`ON MATCH SET`, `CREATE` chain patterns (`(t)-[:Contains]->(:Property {...})-[:IsA]->(s)`), clause ordering validation (MERGE → CREATE → SET → REMOVE → DELETE).

- [duplicateRemoval.test.ts](./duplicateRemoval.test.ts) — Cypher-style duplicate removal via `FOREACH` loops with `DELETE`/`DETACH DELETE`: `MATCH (n:Label) WITH n.key AS key, collect(n) AS nodes WHERE size(nodes) > 1 FOREACH (n1 IN tail(nodes) | DELETE n1)`.
- [standaloneMutations.test.ts](./standaloneMutations.test.ts) — Standalone `CREATE`/`MERGE` without `MATCH` clauses; validates `StartStep` insertion, `ast.mutations` ordering, and error throwing for unbound variables in standalone `DELETE`/`SET`/`REMOVE`.

- [QueryContext.test.ts](./QueryContext.test.ts) — `QueryContext` concurrency isolation, graph scoping, immutability (`withParams()`, `withOptions()`), parameter resolution (`getParam()`, `hasParam()`); tests manual interleaving, round-robin scheduling (10 parallel iterators), async contention with `Promise.all`, and stress tests (100 concurrent queries).

## Patterns

**Test Infrastructure Pattern**: Tests consistently use `makeType<T>(_defaultValue: T): StandardSchemaV1<T>` from [testHelpers.ts](./testHelpers.ts) to construct schema validators with `"~standard": {version: 1, vendor: "codemix"}` protocol; schema definitions use `as const satisfies GraphSchema` for type safety.

**Execution Pipeline Pattern**: `executeQuery(graph, queryString)` chains `parse(queryString)` (returns `Query` AST) → `astToSteps(ast)` (returns `Step[]`) → `createTraverser(steps)` (returns `Traverser`) → `traverser.traverse(graph, [undefined], new QueryContext(graph, params))` (returns `IterableIterator<unknown[]>`) → `Array.from()` materialization.

**Fixture Setup Pattern**: `beforeEach` hooks instantiate `new Graph<typeof schema>({ schema, storage: new InMemoryGraphStorage(), validateProperties: false })` using ephemeral storage for test isolation; demo graphs use `createDemoGraph()` for social network fixtures or `createManufacturingGraph()` for industrial ontologies.

**TCK Pattern**: TCK tests import `createTckGraph()` and `executeTckQuery()` from [tck/tckHelpers.ts](./tck/tckHelpers.ts) to execute openCypher scenario strings against standardized graph structures and assert result counts/values.

## Behavioral Contracts

**Error Message Templates**:

- `VertexNotFoundError`: `"Vertex ${vertexId} not found"`
- `EdgeNotFoundError`: `"Edge ${edgeId} not found"` (matches regex `/^Edge .+ not found$/`)
- `ElementNotFoundError`: `"Element ${elementId} not found"`
- `LabelNotFoundError`: `"Label ${label} not found"`
- `InvalidComparisonError`: `"Cannot compare values of incompatible types: number and string"`
- `MaxIterationsExceededError`: `"Maximum iterations (${limit}) exceeded in ${step}. Consider adding a LIMIT clause or increasing maxIterations."`
- `MemoryLimitExceededError`: `"Collection size (${actual}) exceeds limit (${limit}). Consider adding a LIMIT clause or increasing maxCollectionSize."`
- `PropertyValidationError`: `"Property '${key}' is not valid for label '${label}'"`
- `PropertyTypeError`: `"Property '${key}' on label '${label}' failed validation: ${issues.join('; ')}"`
- `AsyncValidationError`: `"Property '${key}' on label '${label}' returned async validation result (not supported)"`
- `ReadonlyGraphError`: `"Query contains mutation step '${stepName}' but readonly mode is enabled"`
- Procedure argument validation: `/accepts at most 0 argument/`
- Unknown procedure: `/Unknown procedure/`
- Aggregate without GROUP BY: `/Cannot use aggregate.*with.*function.*without GROUP BY/`
- DELETE with connected edges: `/connected edges/`
- Negation error: `"Cannot negate: last step is not a filter step"`

**ID Format Patterns**:

- Element ID structure: `${Label}:${uuid}` (e.g., `Person:12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc`)
- UUID pattern: `/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[9-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/` (variant per test)

**Performance Thresholds**:

- 100-vertex chain traversal: `< 1000ms`
- 1000-level path depth caching (10000 accesses): `< 100ms`
- 100-vertex multi-property sorting: `< 500ms`
- 1000-element array unfold: `< 100ms`

**Date Serialization**:

- `Date` instances convert to ISO 8601 strings via `toJSON()` on `TraversalPath`/`Vertex` (e.g., `"2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z"`)

**Default Resource Limits**:

- `maxIterations`: `1000` (configurable via `QueryContext` constructor options)
- `maxCollectionSize`: `100000` (configurable via `QueryContext` constructor options)

**Quantifier Defaults**:

- `[*]` and `[+]` both set `min: 1`, `max: undefined`
- `[*2]` equivalent to `[{2}]` with `min: 2`, `max: 2`
- `[*1..3]` equivalent to `[{1,3}]` with `min: 1`, `max: 3`

**Temporal Format Specifications**:

- Date: `YYYY-MM-DD` (e.g., `1984-10-11`)
- LocalTime: `HH:MM:SS[.NNNNNNNNN]` (nanoseconds 1-9 digits, trailing zeros trimmed)
- Time: `HH:MM:SS[.NNNNNNNNN](Z|[+-]HH:MM)` (offset stored as seconds)
- LocalDateTime: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.NNNNNNNNN]`
- DateTime: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.NNNNNNNNN][(Z|[+-]HH:MM)][\[Timezone\]]` (e.g., `1984-10-11T12:31:14.645876123+01:00[Europe/Stockholm]`)

## File Relationships

[testHelpers.ts](./testHelpers.ts) exports fixture factories (`createTestGraph`, `createUserPostGraph`, `createFlexibleGraph`, `createComprehensiveGraph`) and `executeQuery()` used by [aggregateSteps.test.ts](./aggregateSteps.test.ts), [arithmetic.test.ts](./arithmetic.test.ts), [queryExecution.test.ts](./queryExecution.test.ts), and 30+ other test files; [getDemoGraph.ts](./getDemoGraph.ts) exports `createDemoGraph()` consumed by [AsyncGraph.test.ts](./AsyncGraph.test.ts), [ComplexTraversals.test.ts](./ComplexTraversals.test.ts), [EdgeTraversal.test.ts](./EdgeTraversal.test.ts), [QueryContext.test.ts](./QueryContext.test.ts), and traversal tests; [createManufacturingGraph.ts](./createManufacturingGraph.ts) provides manufacturing fixtures for [RepeatStep.test.ts](./RepeatStep.test.ts) and industrial domain tests.

Grammar tests ([grammar.test.ts](./grammar.test.ts), [cypher-comparison.test.ts](./cypher-comparison.test.ts)) validate `parse()` from [../grammar.js](./../grammar.js); execution tests import `astToSteps` from [../astToSteps.js](./../astToSteps.js) and `createTraverser`/`QueryContext` from [../Steps.js](./../steps/index.js) to compile and run queries against `InMemoryGraphStorage` from [../GraphStorage.js](./../GraphStorage.js).

TCK tests in [tck/clauses/](./tck/clauses/) and [tck/expressions/](./tck/expressions/) depend on [tck/tckHelpers.ts](./tck/tckHelpers.ts) for `createTckGraph()` and `executeTckQuery()`, which internally use the same `parse()` → `astToSteps()` → `createTraverser()` pipeline as unit tests but with standardized scenario graphs.
